annotations.target_phrase: simstim link, Case tapped into Molly’s sensory input
annotations.annotation_text: Simstim (simulation stimulation) enables full-sensorium broadcast. When Case connects to Molly's transmitter, he experiences an intimate phenomenological dislocation: tasting her chewing gum, feeling the weight of her body, and seeing the world through her silver inset lenses.
sources: Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. (1999).
Murphy, Graham J. William Gibson's Neuromancer: A Critical Companion. Palgrave, 2024.

annotations.target_phrase: gender disjunction, riding a female body through the combat zone
annotations.annotation_text: Case's passive ride inside Molly's sensorium disrupts traditional gender dynamics. The masculine console cowboy becomes a passive observer inhabiting an active, hyper-competent female cyborg warrior, destabilizing patriarchal mastery over action narrative conventions.
sources: Sponsler, Claire. 'Cyberpunk and the Dilemmas of Postmodern Subjectivity.' (1992).
Hollinger, Veronica. 'Cybernetic Deconstructions: Cyberpunk and Postmodernism.' Mosaic, 1990.
